contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (10,778.00) on the p5 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (10,778.00) AND its printed 'Total Contributions Received — Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report' (10,778.00)
contributions.detail: The 12 Schedule A rows on p2 sum to 7500 + 1 + 100 + 250 + 100 + 100 + 2500 + 50 + 100 + 20 + 7 + 50 = 10,778.00 exactly, which equals all three printed figures: the page subtotal, the schedule's own sum-of-all-pages total, and the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Box B. Box C (Year-to-Date, 10,778.00) is the CUMULATIVE cell and is never summed as an increment; on this filing it happens to equal Box B because this is the filer's FIRST report of the cycle (Seven days preceding Convention, 04/01/2022), so period = year-to-date, which is not an anomaly. Box F (Subtotal before Expenditures) 10,778.00 = Box A 0 + Box B 10,778.00 and is consistent.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (8705.50) on the p5 Summary Page, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Total Expenditures Made — Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report' (8705.50, printed identically on p3 and p4); the per-page gate is p3's printed 'Subtotal for this page' 6070.19 and p4's 2635.31
expenditures.detail: TRACED to page 3's own printed subtotal, +0.01. The 15 rows on p3 sum to 757.36 + 3.60 + 45.00 + 75.00 + 294.10 + 56.00 + 50.00 + 24.70 + 35.00 + 31.20 + 3782.71 + 359.82 + 314.51 + 146.18 + 95.00 = 6,070.18, against a printed 'Subtotal for this page' of 6070.19. Page 4's 3 rows sum to 1167.87 + 1453.16 + 14.28 = 2,635.31, which equals its printed subtotal EXACTLY, so the whole discrepancy sits on p3. Rows total 8,705.49 against the printed Total Expenditures Made / Box D of 8705.50. WHAT WAS DONE ABOUT IT: all 15 p3 amount cells were escalated as three 5-row column crops at 900 dpi (~830 effective dpi) and every one reproduced exactly as recorded — these are machine-typed figures on a born-digital fillable form, not handwriting, so no glyph is in doubt. The two printed footers were separately escalated at 900 dpi and read 6070.19 / 8705.50 (p3) and 2635.31 / 8705.50 (p4). The doubled-band screen (ADDENDUM H3) was run: p3's 15 measured bands each rendered exactly one figure, so no band holds two entries. The below-the-last-rule screen (ADDENDUM F1.5 / J6) was run OUTSIDE the full grid, since all 15 rows are used: the strip below the grid renders the printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 6070.19' label and figure, not a further entry. NOTHING WAS NUDGED — a 0.01 could be absorbed by any of fifteen cells, so the closure is not unique (the ADDENDUM C5 standard), and every cell already reproduces at high dpi. The delta is the filer's own arithmetic (a cent of rounding in his own ledger) and is retained verbatim. Correlated-error screen: this filer has two further 2022 filings in this chunk (08dda6af 5/9/2022, 9a60eabb) and the result of that screen is reported by the chunk agent.

So monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind give the same 10,778.00 and the same 8,705.49.

itemized.notes:
Hyrum Cox, Utah County Sheriff, 'Seven days preceding Convention', report date 04/01/2022, NOT an amendment (the No radio is filled). Page-face name 'Hyrum Cox' and page-face office 'Utah County Sheriff' both AGREE with index.csv. modern_boxAF, footer revision 'v. 4.20' printed on every report page — the CARRY-OVER 2022 blank, not the newer unversioned one: its Schedule A has four columns headed Date / Name of Contributor / 'Address and Zip Code' / Amount (NOT 'City and State'), it has NO in-kind checkbox column, its close box is UNLETTERED ('Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)'), it offers FIVE report types, and it foliates 'Date of Report / Page'. Born-digital fillable form, filled by typing, printed and re-scanned; every figure is machine type.

EIGHT PDF PAGES BUT FIVE REPORT SHEETS. p1 cover / p2 Schedule A / p3 Schedule B sheet 1 / p4 Schedule B sheet 2 / p5 SUMMARY PAGE / p6 BLANK VERSO / p7 CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST / p8 BLANK VERSO. Every page was classified from its own printed header. p6 and p8 are genuinely blank versos of a partial duplex scan (ADDENDUM J3) — neither is a schedule and neither is a missing one.

THIS FILING IS HALF OF THE REGISTERED 'utah-checklist-decoy' CONTROL PAIR, AND THE SPECIMEN NOW NEEDS ONE MORE FACT ON THE RECORD. Its p5 IS the genuine Summary Page — confirmed by content: heading 'Summary Page — Note: Complete this page after filling out Schedule A and Schedule B', Box A 0 / Box B 10,778.00 / Box C 10,778.00 / Box D 8705.50 / Box E 8705.50 / Box F 10,778.00 / close 2072.50, and the sheet foliates itself 'Page 5'. But the checklist IS ALSO BOUND INTO THIS FILING, at p7 — the pair is not 'one filing binds a checklist and the other does not', it is 'the SAME ordinal holds different page kinds'. The p7 checklist recites every summary-page label and carries ZERO dollar figures, and it is the two-staff-signature revision (the '#1 / #2' layout with a 'Website / Network / HOLD' box, signed and dated 4/4/22 twice in two different inks). It is born-digital clean while the report pages are photocopy-degraded — the independent tell recorded in ADDENDUM J2.

FOLIATION IS AGAIN WORTHLESS, in a NEW way: the cover's Page box is blank, Schedule A foliates 'Page 2', BOTH Schedule B sheets foliate 'Page 4', and the Summary foliates 'Page 5'. No sheet is numbered 3 and one number is used twice. There is no missing Schedule A sheet: Schedule A's own printed 'Total Contributions Received — Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report' equals its own page subtotal (10,778.00), so that schedule is one page as filed.

REDACTION: the county blacked out the STREET portion of every donor address cell before publication (a redaction bar IS the document), while leaving the city/state/zip line in the clear on 10 of 12 rows. The two exceptions are the filer's own 'anonymous' rows, where the address cell prints the word 'anonymous' and nothing was redacted at all. No street line was carried into any field or note.

The expenditure side carries a +0.01 filer-arithmetic delta localised to page 3's own printed subtotal — traced, escalated cell by cell, and NOT nudged. See recon.expenditures.detail.
